content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: clicking the \"Item 190\" row on the Item (list) screen navigates straight back to Accounts Receivable (report), about 150 ms after the click, in all three sessions, so the row click appears to route to the report instead of an item view.", "fix": "Fix: On the Item (list) screen, check the click handler or link target on the list row element (the \"Item 190\" row at about x=1250, y=275) and make it open that item's detail view instead of returning to the accounts receivable report route.", "cited_event_ids": ["70", "app:2", "356", "458", "66"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["No item detail screen appears in the windows, so the intended destination of a row click is not confirmed.", "The console errors (ids 12, 87, 297, 373, 401, 475) have no message text, so their link to the round trip is unknown.", "The overlay shown and removed events on item:list have no label, so their purpose is unknown.", "The user's goal on the Item list is not visible in the events; the repeated scrolling could be searching, but the events do not establish it.", "Dropped pointer samples mean some pointer movement is missing from the windows."]}
